newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asia Amalgamated to start ferry unit.
newsitem.headline: Asia Amalgamated to start ferry unit.

text.p: Asia Amalgamated Holdings Corp said on Friday its subsidiary, Marilag Transport System Inc, would start its commercial ferry service on April 15.

Asia Amalgamated president Jimmy Cabangis said the ferry will serve as an alternative transport system to the congested land-based Manila-Cavite route. Cavite is an industrial province just south of Manila.
Marilag will use two 60-seater foreign-made catamaran-type vessels for the service.
